stem:
Xavier uses a lifting electromagnet on a crane to move an iron sheet.

When the current in the electromagnet is switched ON, what happens to the iron sheet, and what happens when the current is switched OFF?

options.text: ON: the iron sheet is released. OFF: the iron sheet is lifted.
ON: the iron sheet is lifted. OFF: the iron sheet is released.
ON: the iron sheet is lifted. OFF: the iron sheet keeps being held.
ON: the iron sheet is released. OFF: the iron sheet stays released.

teacher.key_rationale: Current ON lifts iron; current OFF releases it. A reverses ON/OFF. C keeps holding after OFF, conflating temporary electromagnet behaviour with a permanent hold. D omits the ON lift.
